title: U.S. Workers Are More Worried Than Hopeful About Future AI Use in the Workplace
reason: Large national survey of U.S. workers on worry versus hope about AI at work; primary publisher.

title: Americans' Views on Use of AI to Monitor and Evaluate Workers
reason: Shows unease about six employer AI monitoring uses; older than the 2024-2026 preference, kept for monitoring evidence.

title: Workers OK with workplace message monitoring, surveillance of chats and email
reason: Reports survey results on employee comfort with employer monitoring of work chats and email (secondary coverage).

title: Most UK employees use AI at work without permission, Microsoft survey finds
reason: Reports a Microsoft UK survey on unapproved AI use and privacy concern; vendor-commissioned figures.

title: 58% of European Workers Use AI on the Job, But 65% Worry About Data Privacy
reason: Vendor-run survey of 1,000 workers in five European countries on data privacy worries about AI.

title: AI Adoption Is Moving Faster Than Employee Trust
reason: Vendor survey of about 5,400 employees on AI as opportunity and threat and on trust gaps (vendor figures).

title: Zoho survey reveals overwhelming concern and adoption of GenAI in workplace
reason: Vendor survey of U.S. employees on GenAI concern and wanting legislation on AI training with employee data (vendor figures).

title: A survey of over 17,000 people indicates only half of us are willing to trust AI at work
reason: Large 17-country survey on willingness to trust AI at work; pre-ChatGPT, older than the preferred range.

title: More than a third of US workers worried AI will take their jobs
reason: Secondary coverage of a 2025 YouGov poll on worker fear of AI job loss; check against the original YouGov release.

title: Workers voice concerns over AI in the workplace, think it makes them less intelligent
reason: Reports a 2025 Howdy survey of 1,007 full-time workers on fear of losing skills to AI (vendor-commissioned).
